title: Is there a way to make text appear only once per battle?

posts.author: AshyMuted
posts.body: I'm making a game in RPG Maker 2003 and want to include messages during battle to let the play know that they're getting close to the end of a fight. This text shows up every turn, though, and I can't find a way to make it only appear once per-enemy per-fight. I would love to know if there's a way to make it appear once, because the way it currently works is pretty annoying and intrusive.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
I don't currently have 2k3 on my pc, but you could just set up a conditional branch with a switch I believe.
If Ghost blah = Off
Show text
Ghost blah = ON
Then on the maps where these ghosts appear, have a parallel event with the conditional:
If Ghost blah = On
Ghost blah = OFF

posts.author: AshyMuted
posts.body: I somehow never thought about doing that second bit. Thank you so much!

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body: Instead of resetting the switch on the map 60 times per second like you'd do with the parallel process, I'd add a battle event page with trigger at the start of battle (turn 0) to reset it once.
